summary: Four men were arrested at 04:30 BST in police raids at two addresses in Birmingham, West Midlands, in relation to the failed London bombings of 21st July. One of the four, arrested in Heybarnes Road in the Hay Mills area and thought to be suspected of being one of last Thursday's bombers, has been taken to the high security Paddington Green police station in London; police acknowledged using a Taser stun gun in the arrest but said no firearms were used. The other three arrests were made shortly afterwards in Bankdale Road, Washwood Heath, where a suspect package was found and local residents were evacuated, and two men were also arrested at Grantham railway station after information was received from off-duty policemen on a GNER train travelling between Newcastle and Kings Cross.
